argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$p=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='openocd.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId,Name)
$d=@(Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'OK' -and $_.FriendlyName -match '(CMSIS.DAP|DAPLink)' } | Select-Object Status,FriendlyName,InstanceId)
[pscustomobject]@{processes=$p;devices=$d}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5
